e.title: Thinking Framework Skills：把 63 个思维方法按证据强度诚实分级，并做成可执行、必产出具体成果的技能
e.title_en: Thinking Framework Skills: 63 thinking methods graded honestly by evidence strength and shipped as executable Skills that must produce a concrete artifact
e.title_hk: Thinking Framework Skills：把 63 個思維方法按證據強度誠實分級，並做成可執行、必產出具體成果的技能
e.summary: 一个按证据强度诚实分级、可由智能体执行的思维方法技能库：63 个框架被拆到「工作机制」层，每个都标注其证据实际有多强，并要求产出一件具体成果而非一段文字；另含 4 个元技能与 9 个配方，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 等
e.summary_en: An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method Skills: 63 frameworks reduced to their working mechanism, each labelled with how strong its evidence actually is, and required to produce a concrete artifact rather than prose; it also ships 4 meta-skills and 9 recipes for Claude Code, Codex and others
e.summary_hk: 一個按證據強度誠實分級、可由智能體執行的思維方法技能庫：63 個框架被拆到「工作機制」層，每個都標註其證據實際有多強，並要求產出一件具體成果而非一段文字；另含 4 個元技能與 9 個配方，適用於 Claude Code、Codex 等
e.body:
**Thinking Framework Skills** 是一个**按证据强度分级的思维方法 Agent 技能库**，**Apache-2.0 许可，实测 ★15、fork 1、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 3,550 KB、创建于 2026-05-17、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测达 20 项**，含 **evidence-based、critical-thinking、decision-making、mental-models、systems-thinking、reasoning、structured-thinking、cognitive-tools、agent-skills、claude-code、codex** 等（**其中 `product-managment` 为仓库自身拼写，照实记录**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「Agent 技能里的证据自觉」**中的**第三种：给方法本身分级****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，55,505 字节**）：**README 逐字定位**：**「An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method skills.」**；⭐⭐ **其逐字承诺有三层**：**「Every method is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is, and shipped as a skill that produces a concrete artifact, not prose.」**——**① 每个方法都被拆到**工作机制**层；② 按「其证据实际有多强」**诚实分级**；③ 交付为**产出具体成果而非一段文字**的技能**。**规模逐字实测**：**63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes**，**并自述为「Advanced (Gold) tier」**。⭐ **目录（catalog）逐字实测为 12 组、并带组内计数**：**Problem Framing（6）／Divergent Ideation（6）／Perspective & Multi-Lens（2）／Systems & Consequences（9）／Assumption & Belief Challenge（5）／Reasoning Clarity（5）／Decision & Option Evaluation（12）／Strategy & Opportunity（2）／Ethics & Values Deliberation（4）／⭐Risk & Resilience（4）／Synthesis（4）／Meta-Thinking & Reflection（4）**。**章节结构逐字实测**：**What this is / Quick start / ⭐What makes it different / The library at a glance / ⭐The evidence model / The catalog / Tools (meta-skills) / How a skill works / Recipes**；**并给出线上站点 `thinking-framework-skills.productonpurpose.com`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is（按其证据实际有多强诚实分级）」是本轮最值得注意的一句话，也是它与本词条所在站点最深的共鸣**——**思维方法类内容最常见的失败是**把有趣等同于有效****：**「第一性原理」「六顶思考帽」听起来都好用，但背后证据强度差异极大**；**一个库主动把「证据有多强」做成字段，而不是把 63 个方法一律推销**，**这本身就是一种智力诚实**；**对精算与风险学生，这种「先分级再使用」的态度与精算里**按证据强弱区分方法与假设**是同一种纪律**（**⚠️ 本次未读「The evidence model」正文，故不转述其分级的具体档位、判据或每个框架的评级——这是本条最关键的未核实项**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「risk & resilience（风险与韧性）」被单列为一组、含 4 个方法，是本条与风险专业最直接的交集**——**加之「Decision & Option Evaluation」一组多达 12 个（全库最多）**，**说明该库的重心在**决策与风险****，**而非泛泛的头脑风暴**；**对需要做承保/定价/资本决策的学生，这是一份现成的「决策前该问哪些问题」清单**（**本次未打开任何具体框架页，故不转述其内容**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「produces a concrete artifact, not prose（产出具体成果而非一段文字）」是一条很硬的设计约束**——**它把「聊完之后什么也没留下」这一 AI 对话通病写成了反面要求**；**这与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、[[ins-mmbench]] 的基准评测、以及同轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的托管检查同属一种做法：**给产出设定可被指认的形态****。**④ ⭐ 「What makes it different」单设一节、而「The evidence model」单设一节**——**前者是差异化主张、后者是评级依据**，**把「宣传」与「依据」分开写**，**这在方法类项目里不常见**（**本次未读两节正文，故不转述其主张与依据**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「How a skill works」单设一节说明该库对**技能结构本身**有明确约定**（**本次未读，故不转述其结构约定**）。**⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 许可 + 明确的自述分级标准，使它成为本会话收集的 Agent 技能中**许可最清晰、且对自身证据强度最坦白**的一条**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐⭐ 本条目最关键的未核实项是**证据分级本身****——**本次只读到 README 的章节标题与三段定位语句，**未读「The evidence model」正文**，**故**不转述其分级档位、判据、评分方式，也不转述 63 个框架中任何一个的具体评级****；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 20 项、README（55,505 字节）的定位语句、规模数字、12 组目录及组内计数与章节结构**，**未安装任何技能、未在 Agent 客户端运行、未打开任何具体框架文件、未访问其线上站点**，因此**不能转述任何框架的内容、适用条件或产出形态**；**③ ⭐ 「63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes」「12 组及组内计数」均为**README 自述值****，**本次未逐一点数核实**（**⚠️ 12 组计数相加为 63，与自述总数自洽，属算术核对而非独立核实**）；**④ ⭐ 「Advanced (Gold) tier」的分级来源与含义本次未核实**，**词条内仅作自述转述**；**⑤ 「graded honestly」中的「honestly」是**自我评价**，**本条目不主张其分级已获独立检验或学界认可**；**⑥ ★15 说明有一定关注度但不算高**，**不主张其被广泛采用或经专业验证**；**⑦ 「produce a concrete artifact」的实际执行效果、以及「reduced to its working mechanism」的还原是否准确，本次均未核实**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**本次未访问其线上站点**）；**⑨** 本词条**不主张**该库适用于保险精算监管场景下的决策**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/product-on-purpose/thinking-framework-skills` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 55,505 字节；本次只逐字读取其定位语句、规模数字、目录结构与章节标题，**未读各章节正文**）；**未安装、未运行、未打开任何框架文件、未访问线上站点**。
e.body_en:
**Thinking Framework Skills** is an **evidence-graded library of thinking-method agent Skills**, **Apache-2.0 licensed, with measured ★15, 1 fork, JavaScript as the primary language, a 3,550 KB repository, created 2026-05-17 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably number 20**, including **evidence-based, critical-thinking, decision-making, mental-models, systems-thinking, reasoning, structured-thinking, cognitive-tools, agent-skills, claude-code and codex** (**of which `product-managment` is the repository’s own spelling, recorded as found**). It belongs to the third of this round’s four ways agent Skills handle evidence: **grading the methods themselves**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 55,505-byte README**): the **README positions it verbatim** as **"An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method skills."**; ⭐⭐ **its promise has three parts, verbatim**: **"Every method is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is, and shipped as a skill that produces a concrete artifact, not prose."** — **① every method is reduced to its mechanism; ② graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is; ③ shipped as a Skill that produces a concrete artifact rather than prose**. **Scale read verbatim**: **63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes**, **self-described as an "Advanced (Gold) tier"**. ⭐ **The catalog measurably has 12 groups with per-group counts**: **Problem Framing (6) / Divergent Ideation (6) / Perspective & Multi-Lens (2) / Systems & Consequences (9) / Assumption & Belief Challenge (5) / Reasoning Clarity (5) / Decision & Option Evaluation (12) / Strategy & Opportunity (2) / Ethics & Values Deliberation (4) / ⭐ Risk & Resilience (4) / Synthesis (4) / Meta-Thinking & Reflection (4)**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **What this is / Quick start / ⭐ What makes it different / The library at a glance / ⭐ The evidence model / The catalog / Tools (meta-skills) / How a skill works / Recipes**; **with a live site at `thinking-framework-skills.productonpurpose.com`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is" is the round’s most notable sentence and its deepest resonance with the site this entry lives on** — **the usual failure of thinking-method content is equating interesting with effective**: **first principles and six thinking hats all sound useful, yet the strength of evidence behind them varies enormously**; **a library that makes "how strong is the evidence" a field instead of uniformly promoting 63 methods is itself an act of intellectual honesty**; **for actuarial and risk students, grading before using is the same discipline as distinguishing methods and assumptions by evidential strength in actuarial work** (**⚠️ the "evidence model" body was not read, so its tiers, criteria and any individual framework rating are not restated — this is the entry’s most important unverified item**). **② ⭐⭐ "Risk & Resilience" as its own group of 4 is the most direct intersection with the risk profession** — **and with "Decision & Option Evaluation" having 12 items, the largest group of all, the library’s centre of gravity is decision and risk rather than generic brainstorming**; **for students making underwriting, pricing or capital decisions, a ready-made list of questions to ask before deciding** (**no framework page was opened, so none of their content is restated**). **③ ⭐⭐ "Produces a concrete artifact, not prose" is a hard design constraint** — **it writes the common AI-conversation failure of "nothing left behind after the chat" into a requirement’s negative**; **the same practice as the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], the benchmark evaluation of [[ins-mmbench]] and the hosted checks of [[powmcp-skills]]: give the output a form that can be pointed at**. **④ ⭐ Having both "What makes it different" and "The evidence model" as separate sections** — **one the differentiation claim, the other the grading basis** — **separates marketing from grounds, which is uncommon among method libraries** (**neither body was read, so neither is restated**). **⑤ ⭐ "How a skill works" as its own section implies the library has explicit conventions for Skill structure itself** (**not read**). **⑥ ⭐ An Apache-2.0 licence plus a stated grading standard make this the clearest-licensed and most candid-about-its-own-evidence item among the agent Skills collected in this session**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐⭐ The entry’s most important unverified item is the grading itself** — **only the README section headings and three positioning sentences were read; the "evidence model" body was not** — **so its tiers, criteria and scoring, and the rating of any individual framework among the 63, are not restated**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, 20 topics, and the README’s 55,505 bytes in respect of positioning statements, scale figures, the 12-group catalog with counts, and section structure**, **but installed no Skill, ran nothing in an agent client, opened no framework file and did not visit its live site**, so **no framework’s content, applicability or output form can be restated**; **③ ⭐ "63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes" and the 12 group counts are README self-reports**, **not counted and verified here** (**⚠️ the 12 group counts sum to 63, which is arithmetic consistency with the stated total, not independent verification**); **④ ⭐ the origin and meaning of "Advanced (Gold) tier" were not verified**, **and the entry reports it only as a self-description**; **⑤ "Honestly" in "graded honestly" is a self-assessment**, **and the entry does not claim the grading has been independently examined or academically accepted**; **⑥ ★15 indicates moderate attention**, **so no claim of wide adoption or professional validation is made**; **⑦ the real-world effect of "produce a concrete artifact", and whether the reduction "to its working mechanism" is accurate, were not verified**; **⑧ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**its live site was not visited**); **⑨** this entry **does not claim the library is suitable for decision-making in actuarial regulatory settings**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/product-on-purpose/thinking-framework-skills` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (README 55,505 bytes; only the positioning statements, scale figures, catalog structure and section headings were read verbatim, **not any section body**); **nothing installed, run, or opened beyond the README, and the live site was not visited**.
e.body_hk:
**Thinking Framework Skills** 是一個**按證據強度分級的思維方法 Agent 技能庫**，**Apache-2.0 許可，實測 ★15、fork 1、主語言 JavaScript、體量 3,550 KB、創建於 2026-05-17、最後推送 2026-09-10**；**topics 逐字實測達 20 項**，含 **evidence-based、critical-thinking、decision-making、mental-models、systems-thinking、reasoning、agent-skills、claude-code、codex**（**其中 `product-managment` 為倉庫自身拼寫，照實記錄**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「Agent 技能裡的證據自覺」**中的**第三種：給方法本身分級****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，55,505 位元組**）：**逐字定位**：**「An evidence-graded library of agent-executable thinking-method skills.」**；⭐⭐ **逐字承諾三層**：**「Every method is reduced to its working mechanism, graded honestly on how strong its evidence actually is, and shipped as a skill that produces a concrete artifact, not prose.」**。**規模逐字實測**：**63 frameworks + 4 tools + 9 recipes**，自述為 **Advanced (Gold) tier**。⭐ **目錄逐字實測為 12 組並帶組內計數**：**Problem Framing（6）／Divergent Ideation（6）／Perspective & Multi-Lens（2）／Systems & Consequences（9）／Assumption & Belief Challenge（5）／Reasoning Clarity（5）／Decision & Option Evaluation（12）／Strategy & Opportunity（2）／Ethics & Values Deliberation（4）／⭐Risk & Resilience（4）／Synthesis（4）／Meta-Thinking & Reflection（4）**。**章節結構逐字實測**含 **⭐What makes it different** 與 **⭐The evidence model** 兩節；**並給出線上站點**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「按其證據實際有多強誠實分級」是本輪最值得注意的一句話，也是它與本站最深的共鳴**——**思維方法類內容最常見的失敗是**把有趣等同於有效****：**「第一性原理」「六頂思考帽」聽起來都好用，但背後證據強度差異極大**；**一個庫主動把「證據有多強」做成欄位，而不是把 63 個方法一律推銷，本身就是一種智力誠實**（**⚠️ 本次未讀「The evidence model」正文，故不轉述其分級檔位、判據或任何框架的評級——這是本條最關鍵的未核實項**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「Risk & Resilience」單列為一組（4 個），是本條與風險專業最直接的交集**——**加之「Decision & Option Evaluation」多達 12 個（全庫最多），說明該庫重心在**決策與風險****。**③ ⭐⭐ 「產出具體成果而非一段文字」是一條很硬的設計約束**——**它把「聊完之後什麼也沒留下」這一 AI 對話通病寫成反面要求**（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[ins-mmbench]]、[[powmcp-skills]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐ 「What makes it different」與「The evidence model」分設兩節**——**前者是差異化主張、後者是評級依據**，**把「宣傳」與「依據」分開寫，在方法類項目裡不常見**。**⑤ ⭐ 「How a skill works」單設一節說明其對**技能結構本身**有明確約定**。**⑥ ⭐ Apache-2.0 許可＋明確的自述分級標準，使其成為本會話收集的 Agent 技能中**許可最清晰、且對自身證據強度最坦白**的一條**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⭐⭐ 本條目最關鍵的未核實項是**證據分級本身****——**本次只讀到章節標題與三段定位語句，**未讀「The evidence model」正文**，**故不轉述其分級檔位、判據、評分方式，也不轉述任何一個框架的具體評級****；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、topics 20 項、README（55,505 位元組）的定位語句、規模數字、12 組目錄及組內計數與章節結構**，**未安裝任何技能、未在 Agent 客戶端運行、未打開任何具體框架文件、未訪問其線上站點**；**③ ⭐ 規模數字與 12 組計數均為**README 自述值**，未逐一點數核實**（**⚠️ 12 組計數相加為 63，與自述總數自洽，屬算術核對而非獨立核實**）；**④ ⭐ 「Advanced (Gold) tier」的來源與含義未核實**；**⑤ 「graded honestly」中的「honestly」是**自我評價**，不主張其分級已獲獨立檢驗或學界認可**；**⑥ ★15 說明有一定關注度但不算高**；**⑦ 「產出具體成果」的實際執行效果、以及「還原到工作機制」是否準確，本次均未核實**；**⑧ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑨** 本詞條**不主張**該庫適用於保險精算監管場景下的決策**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/product-on-purpose/thinking-framework-skills` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未安裝、未運行、未打開任何框架文件、未訪問線上站點**。
